title: Recycle only when you have to!
abstract: arXiv:2610.40665v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AlphaFold 3-like models (e.g., Boltz, Protenix, etc.) have pushed the frontier of protein binder design. This architecture is used both for the generation of binder candidates (e.g., by hallucination or converting these models into backbone or full atom generative models) as well as for the screening of these candidates for valid binders. In this paper, we start from the observation that AlphaFold 3's confidence metrics (ipSAE, ipTM) as well as structural consistency metrics can be predicted directly from the trunk even at early recycling. Because our proposed predictor is cheap, differentiable, and available at every cycle, it can be used in two distinct ways: as a decision signal to wisely spend the recycling budget for screening and as an objective for hallucination-based design. We show that both applications lead to increased performance at significantly reduced computational cost.

translated_title: 仅在必要时才进行循环！
translated_abstract: 类似于AlphaFold 3的模型（如Boltz、Protenix等）推动了蛋白质结合剂（binder）设计的前沿。该架构既用于生成结合剂候选（例如通过幻觉式生成或将这些模型转换为骨架或全原子生成模型），也用于筛选这些候选以获得有效的结合剂。在本文中，我们从一个观察出发：AlphaFold 3的置信度指标（ipSAE、ipTM）以及结构一致性指标即使在早期循环阶段，也可以直接从主干网络（trunk）预测得到。由于我们提出的预测器成本低廉、可微分，并且在每个循环周期中都可用，因此它可以以两种不同的方式使用：一是作为决策信号，在筛选时明智地分配循环预算；二是作为幻觉式设计的目标函数。我们证明，这两种应用都能在显著降低计算成本的同时提升性能。
tldr: 该论文提出一种低成本、可微分的预测器，可在早期循环阶段直接预测AlphaFold 3的置信度指标，既能作为筛选时智能分配循环预算的决策信号，又能作为幻觉式蛋白质结合剂设计的目标函数，从而在大幅降低计算成本的同时提升设计性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cheap and differentiable predictor that forecasts AlphaFold 3's confidence metrics at early recycling stages, serving both as a decision signal to wisely allocate the recycling budget during screening and as an objective for hallucination-based binder design, improving performance at significantly reduced computational cost.
